name: Bangkok
about: Cool season (Nov–Feb) is the pleasant window; hot season (Mar–May) is brutal, monsoon (Jun–Oct) brings frequent downpours.
overview: Ornate temples, legendary street food, and round-the-clock energy, at some of Asia's most accessible prices.
costOverview: Street food and transit are nearly free; real spending happens at rooftop bars and hotel restaurants.
